## The gate (please answer first)

- Is this already in [ARCHITECTURE.md](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) or a
  [milestone epic](../../docs/issues/README.md)? If yes, link the section — this
  becomes a scheduling request, not a design request.
- If no: this is an **architecture change** and needs an ADR proposal
  ([docs/adr/](../../docs/adr/README.md)). A maintainer will convert it. New
  ideas are welcome; silent scope creep is not
  ([IMPLEMENTATION-MODE.md](../../docs/IMPLEMENTATION-MODE.md)).
